notes: No identifiable individual star meets the criteria. The hypervelocity-star discussion at T:p5-b2 refers only to an unnamed stellar population and does not establish a present-day Galactic-unbound criterion for any identified star. Other high-speed or distant systems discussed in the paper (e.g., the possible ejection of M33 at T:p8-b3) are galaxies, clusters, or streams rather than individual stars.
